title: 第33章 范金花怒了
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 巴儿姐蹲在一棵歪脖子老槐树底下，抱着肚子。徐喜弟放慢了脚步，慢慢走过去。“你肚子里有娃，可不能像从前那样乱跑，会肚子疼。”徐喜弟在她旁边蹲下来，一边说，一边用手比划。巴儿姐抬起头，似乎很疼，五官都有些扭曲，她肚子从来没这么疼过。徐喜弟干脆在她旁边坐下了，她也不知道大肚子的女人，肚子疼应该做哪些措施来缓解。就只能静静等着她恢复好转。看着她的肚子，四五个月应该是有了。也就是说，村里那些光棍汉，至少在五个月前，就已经盯着巴儿姐。孩子都未必是赵丁的，是李二拐的也说不准。这样想，徐喜弟开始茫然起来。在农村，一个残障人士突然怀了孩子，爹都不确定是谁的。往后的日子，该怎么办？孩子生下来，也要被人指指点点。她不由自主摸了摸自己的肚子。巴儿姐生的孩子被人耻笑，她的孩子就不会吗？在农村，没爹没妈的孩子，最容易受欺负，成为孩子们群攻的对象。“好了就回家吧。”看巴儿姐似乎好了很多，徐喜弟拉着她回家。刚回到村口，范金花也追了过来。“你们跑哪儿去了，我在村里转了好几圈，没出啥事吧？”看到巴儿姐脸色惨白，范金花多少还是担心的。“先回家。”“爸那边还好吗？”提到张国海，范金花老脸就是一沉。“磕着腰了，现在床上躺着。”三人正进村，就看到刘烨扛着踩犁和钉锄，要出村。“嫂子，出啥事了？”刘烨见四人仓惶又狼狈，停住脚步，目光在徐喜弟身上转了一圈，最后落在巴儿姐被打青的胳膊上。“没事。”范金花明显在遮掩，“家里闹了点误会。”刘烨没吭声，他看了看张家的方向，又看看巴儿姐。这一看就是打的呀！“嫂子，家里有什么需要帮忙，尽管叫我，白天我在小羊山开荒。”刘烨指着小羊山的方向说道。“怎么去小羊山开荒？”范金花脱口问道，“那座山种不了东西，你咋这么傻跑去那儿开山？”“喜弟说，头两年舍得下肥，养两年就会肥起来……”范金花这时候没心思听这个，只瞟了徐喜弟一眼，总归是小姑娘家，不懂地里的事，瞎给傻子出主意。“行，那你去忙吧，我们家里还有事得先回去。”说完就匆匆拉着巴儿姐回家。刘烨站在原地，看着她们三人进村，总觉得哪里不对。……回到家，还没进门，就听见屋里张国海父子俩嚎叫。“哎哟……哎哟喂……”“你们都不管我，那我死好了。”此起彼伏。一个家，被这两个人嚎得阴气沉沉。范金花也不管，往灶里重新起火煮猪食。猪圈里的三头猪，叫得全村都能听见。徐喜弟拉着巴儿姐坐到灶前的小凳上。“我们先吃早饭吧。”巴儿姐没说话，默默把刚刚丢在一边的糍粑，就着灶里剩下的那点余火接着烤。吃早饭的时候，徐喜弟问了一句，“妈，要不要找烨叔，带爸去镇上看看？他这么叫，应该是真伤到了。”“先不管他，让他叫。”范金花阴沉着脸，快速吃完碗里的粥，就去忙喂猪的事。这下好了。家里又多一个不能自理的，还有一个大肚子的。往后的日子，还怎么过！徐喜弟吃完饭，有些于心不忍，她走进张国海的屋子，一股子汗味和药油味扑面而来。张国海趴在床上，脸朝着墙，一声接一声地哀嚎。“爸，你怎么样？要不要紧？”“滚！都给我滚！”张国海头也不回，知道有人进来，也不管是谁，张口就骂，“养你们有什么用？一个两个都是讨债鬼！老子死了，你们就都安生了！”徐喜弟摸摸鼻子，默默退了出来。她来到火房，皱着眉，小声提议。“妈，要不……送爸去镇上医院看看吧？阿福也喊了三天疼，万一真摔出什么毛病来……”话没说完，就被范金花打断了。“看？拿什么看？”对方像是听到了天大的笑话，转过头没好气回道，“你当去医院不用钱？开副药不得几块钱？你身上有钱，还是我有钱？”“家里那点米，还能吃几天都不知道。家里所有的钱，早让你爸拿买牛崽子了！”“自己啥也不干，买个牛崽子回来，还不是我们两个养。他一天就只负责动嘴皮，我们累死累活！”范金花越说越气，声音也大了起来。“哼，他现在真死了才好！我们养猪养牛，还能对家里有用。那两个废人，吃光不干活就算了，现在吃喝拉撒还得管！”徐喜弟知道，婆婆这是厌弃了这种被拖累的日子。自己也不好吭声，虽然她也很想摆脱这样的累赘，可咒别人死，她又做不出来。而且这个时候跟范金花争辩，没有任何意义。这个家穷得叮当响，这是事实。“哎哟……疼死我了……范金花，你个死婆娘，还不快给我端碗水来！渴死我了！”屋里的张国海又开始叫唤。隔壁屋的张永福听见动静，也跟着嚎。“我也要喝水！妈！我要喝水！你们都死了吗？！”范金花猛地站起来，冲进屋，不知道从哪里端了半碗水，重重地放在张国海床头。“喝！喝死你！”然后又冲进张永福的屋，同样的操作。“你也喝！都喝！喝完了好上路！”徐喜弟看着这一幕，心里五味杂陈，此刻她是真没有什么主意。巴儿姐还在烤她的糍粑，对屋里的鸡飞狗跳充耳不闻，仿佛这一切都与她无关。范金花从屋里出来，脸色十分难看。“喜弟，你等下把猪喂了，我回娘家一趟。”“回娘家？”徐喜弟一愣。“我娘家村里有个老郎中，祖上传下来的手艺，专治跌打损伤。我去找他抓几服药回来，给你爸贴上，死不了人。”范金花说得轻描淡写，但徐喜弟知道，这恐怕是她能想到的唯一办法了。“那我跟你一起去？”徐喜弟脱口而出。她不怕范金花回娘家求药，怕她一去不返。这个家要是就这样撂给她，她想想眼前就一片蒙黑。“你去做什么？家里这两个躺床的，谁来管？你就老老实实在家待着。”范金花站起身，开始收拾东西，其实也没什么好收拾的，就是找了两件换洗的衣服，用布包了起来。“还有，”她走到门口，又回过头，压低了声音，“看好巴儿姐，别让她再到处乱跑。她那肚子……等我回来再说。”说完，范金花头也不回地走了。
content_en: Sister Ba'er squatted under an old locust tree with a crooked neck, holding her belly.Xu Xidi slowed down and walked over slowly."You have a baby in your belly, so you can't run around like before, or you'll get a stomachache." Xu Xidi squatted down next to her and said, gesturing with his hands.Sister Ba'er raised her head, it seemed that she was in pain, her facial features were a little distorted, and her stomach had never been so painful.Xu Xidi simply sat down next to her. She didn't know what measures a woman with a big belly should take to relieve stomachache.I can only wait quietly for her to recover.Looking at her belly, it should be four or five months old.In other words, the bachelors in the village had been eyeing Sister Ba'er at least five months ago.The child may not be Zhao Ding's, nor may it be Li Erguai's.Thinking this way, Xu Xidi began to feel confused.In a rural area, a disabled person suddenly became pregnant. The father was not sure whose child it was.What should we do in the days to come?When a child is born, he will be criticized.She couldn't help but touch her belly.Sister Ba'er's child was ridiculed, wouldn't her child be ridiculed?In rural areas, children without parents are most vulnerable to bullying and become the targets of group attacks."Let's go home when you're ready." Seeing that Sister Ba'er seemed to be much better, Xu Xidi took her home.As soon as they returned to the village entrance, Fan Jinhua also chased after him."Where did you go? I walked around the village several times. Nothing happened?" Seeing Sister Ba'er's pale face, Fan Jinhua was somewhat worried."Go home first." "How are you doing, dad?" When Zhang Guohai was mentioned, Fan Jinhua's old face sank."I'm slumped, and I'm lying on the bed now." The three of them were entering the village when they saw Liu Ye carrying a plow and a hoe to leave the village."Sister-in-law, what happened?" Seeing the four people in a panic and embarrassment, Liu Ye stopped and looked around Xu Xidi, finally landing on Sister Ba'er's bruised arm."It's okay." Fan Jinhua was obviously covering up, "There was a misunderstanding at home." Liu Ye didn't say anything. He looked in the direction of the Zhang family and then at Sister Ba'er.It looks like he was beaten!"Sister-in-law, if you need help at home, just call me. During the day, I will open up wasteland in Xiaoyang Mountain." Liu Ye pointed in the direction of Xiaoyang Mountain and said."How to go to Xiaoyang Mountain to open up wasteland?" Fan Jinhua asked blurtly, "You can't grow anything on that mountain, why are you so stupid to go there to open up a mountain?" "Xidi said that if you are willing to fertilize in the first two years, it will become fatter in two years..." Fan Jinhua was not in the mood to listen to this at this time, and only glanced at Xu Xidi. After all, it was a little girl's family who didn't understand the things in the field and gave blind advice to fools."Okay, then go and do your work. We have things to do at home and have to go back first." After saying that, he hurriedly took Sister Ba'er home.Liu Ye stood there and watched the three of them enter the village, always feeling that something was wrong....When I got home, before I even entered the door, I heard Zhang Guohai and his son howling in the house."Ouch... Ouch..." "If you don't care about me, then I'll die." one after another.A home was filled with gloom and gloom by these two people.Fan Jinhua didn't care and started cooking pig food again in the stove.The three pigs in the pigsty screamed so loudly that the whole village could hear them.Xu Xidi pulled Sister Ba'er to sit on the small stool in front of the stove."Let's have breakfast first." Sister Ba'er said nothing, silently roasting the glutinous rice cake she had just thrown aside on the remaining fire in the stove.While eating breakfast, Xu Xidi asked, "Mom, do you want to find Uncle Ye and take Dad to the town? He must be really hurt when he barks like that." "Ignore him for now and let him bark." Fan Jinhua had a gloomy face, quickly finished the porridge in the bowl, and went to feed the pigs.It's better now.There is one more person in the family who cannot take care of himself, and another one with a big belly.How will you live in the future?After Xu Xidi finished eating, she felt a little unbearable. When she walked into Zhang Guohai's house, the smell of sweat and medicinal oil hit her face.Zhang Guohai lay on the bed, facing the wall, wailing one after another."Dad, how are you? Is it okay?" "Get out! Get out of here!" Zhang Guohai didn't even look back. When he knew someone was coming in, no matter who it was, he opened his mouth and cursed, "What's the point of raising you? Both of them are debt collectors! If I die, you will all live in peace!" Xu Xidi touched his nose and silently withdrew.She came to the fire room, frowned, and whispered a suggestion."Mom, why don't you...send dad to the hospital in town for a checkup? Ah Fu has been complaining about pain for three days. If something happens to him after the fall..." Before he could finish his words, he was interrupted by Fan Jinhua."Look? What are you looking at?" The other party seemed to have heard a big joke. He turned around and replied angrily, "You think you don't have to pay to go to the hospital? How many yuan can you get for prescription medicine? Do you have money, or do I?" "With the little rice at home, I don't know how many days I can last..All the money in the family has been used by your father to buy a cow!" "You don't have to do anything to buy a cow, and it's not just the two of us who are responsible for the whole day, we are exhausted!" Fan Jinhua became more and more angry, and her voice became louder."Humph, it would be great if he is really dead now! We raise pigs and cows, and we can still be useful to the family. Those two losers just eat everything and don't work. Now they have to take care of eating, drinking, and diarrhea!" Xu Xidi knew that her mother-in-law was tired of this kind of burdened life.She couldn't keep silent either. Although she also wanted to get rid of such a burden, she couldn't curse others to death.And there is no point in arguing with Fan Jinhua at this time.This family was extremely poor, that was a fact."Ouch...it hurts me so much...Fan Jinhua, you damn bitch, why don't you bring me a bowl of water! I'm dying of thirst!" Zhang Guohai from inside the room started shouting again.Zhang Yongfu in the next room heard the noise and howled too."I want to drink water too! Mom! I want to drink water! Are you all dead?!" Fan Jinhua stood up suddenly, rushed into the room, picked up half a bowl of water from somewhere, and placed it heavily on Zhang Guohai's bedside."Drink! Drink you to death!" Then he rushed into Zhang Yongfu's house and did the same thing."You drink too! Drink them all! After you finish drinking, you can hit the road!" Xu Xidi looked at this scene with mixed emotions in her heart. She really had no idea at the moment.Sister Ba'er was still baking her glutinous rice cakes, turning a deaf ear to the commotion in the room, as if it had nothing to do with her.Fan Jinhua came out of the room with a very ugly face."Xidi, you feed the pigs later and I'll go back to my parents' house." "Back to my parents' house?" Xu Xidi was stunned."There is an old doctor in my natal village who specializes in treating bruises and bruises with skills passed down from my ancestors. I will go to him to grab some medicine and bring it back to your father. It will not kill anyone." Fan Jinhua said it lightly, but Xu Xidi knew that this was probably the only way she could think of."Then shall I go with you?" Xu Xidi blurted out.She was not afraid that Fan Jinhua would go back to her parents' house to ask for medicine, but she was afraid that she would never return.If this family was left to her like this, her eyes would be filled with darkness just thinking about it."What are you going to do? Who will take care of the two people lying in bed at home? Just stay at home." Fan Jinhua stood up and started to pack things. In fact, there was nothing to pack. She just found two changes of clothes and wrapped them in cloth."Also," she walked to the door, turned back and lowered her voice, "Watch Sister Ba'er and don't let her run around again. Her belly... I'll talk about it when I come back." After saying that, Fan Jinhua left without looking back.
